messages:
olivia: :rotating_light: seeing kv cache memory blowup after rolling long-context sliding window up for YaRN experiment. sudden continuous-batch sizes jumped from ~40->400 and per-token latency spiked. multiple customers report 502s and tail latencies >5s. reproducing on prod region eu-west-1.
incident-bot: Paging oncall(s) for incidents channel. severity: P1. Pager routed to mike (primary) and katia (secondary). Link: https://redwood.incidents/2412345678
mike: on it. grabbing logs & traffic graphs. olivia can you paste the exact flag/config you changed and time?
olivia: changed feature long_window.size from 50 -> 200 at 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z. also enabled yarn_prefetch=true for the rollout.
katia: seeing the same in metrics: rope-serve.kv.prefetch_evictions spiked, kv_hit_ratio dropped from 0.92 -> 0.46. continuous_batch.size p50 went to 380.
ben: customer impact numbers: 7 tenants show increased 5xxs, ~9k failed requests in last 10m, error rate from 0.3% -> 3.7%. top impacted product: chat-gen on eu-west-1.
jordan: logs show repeated "kv_cache: miss + prefetch kickstart -> full_kv_collision" and GC pressure. stack traces attached.
olivia: rolling the flag back now. curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://console.api/flags/long_window.size -d '{"value":50}'
deploy-bot: Flag change accepted. rollout to 100% initiated (id: f-98c7).
mike: temporary mitigation: reduce continuous_batch.max_tokens to 64 on rope workers in eu-west-1. run: kubectl -n inference set env ds/rope-serve CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=64 --record
katia: applied reduction on 4/6 nodes. batch sizes already falling on those nodes.
olivia: applying kv eviction tuning: set KV_PREFETCH_WINDOW=32 and KV_MAX_EVICT_RATE=0.12 via configmap update.
ben: after rollback + batch cap + eviction tuning, 5xxs dropped to 0.9% in 12m, latency p95 down from 5.2s -> 1.1s. still above baseline but improving.
jordan: note: NTK score (sequence length) distribution shifted because our retriever prepended long system prompts; that increased prefix KV pressure. recommend adding prefix-based cache-bypass for >8k tokens.
mike: agreed. creating follow-up task in Jira INC-4521: "Investigate long-window prefetch interaction with YaRN/NTK leading to kv-cache blowups". assign to eng-runtime.
olivia: FYI we did a soft-fallback routing to dedicated capacity for high-risk tenants (route policy: model=redwood-l2 -> dedicated-eu). customer-ops-bot notified affected tenants with status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2412345678
customer-ops-bot: Notified 7 customers at 09:33 UTC. template used: "We're seeing elevated errors in eu-west-1 related to long-context prefetching. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with post-incident summary."
ben: quick root-cause hypothesis: sliding-window increase caused prefetch window to overlap more unique KV keys per request -> massive cache growth + eviction backlog -> continuous batching controller increased batch sizes because more requests were waiting on KV loads -> cascading latency.
katia: immediate action items: 1) revert long_window.size in config → done. 2) keep CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=64 for next 4h. 3) enable prefix-bypass for requests with ntk_estimate>8k (staged). 4) add circuit-breaker so prefetch doesn't exceed X keys per request.
mike: handoff to night SRE: track kv memory usage and prefetch queue depth every 5m, paged if evictions/sec > 200 or batch_size_p50 > 200. leaving notes in the oncall doc.
olivia: taking notes for postmortem. will include timeline, customer impact, graphs, config diffs, and remediation plan.
incident-bot: Incident P1 closed to active mitigation. owners: eng-runtime + oncall-sre. create postmortem within 72h.
ben: thumbs up on mitigations. need to run chaos test to verify prefetch safety boundaries before re-enabling long_window.size > 100. :thumbsup:
jordan: adding suggested quick test snippet for dev env: ```bash
# simulate high-ntk workload
python tools/simulate_requests.py --count 1000 --ntk 12000 --prefetch-window 200 --concurrency 50
```
olivia: final note: no data exfiltration, only performance impact. keeping stakeholders updated. will ping eng-runtime for on-call sync at 13:00 UTC for handoff report. :white_check_mark:
